title: EVAVO Vector Studio
description: A private EVAVO production workspace for professional raster reconstruction, editable SVG, directed motion, Lottie delivery and governed automation.
capabilities: SVG topology, geometry and editability evidence
Animated SVG, Lottie JSON and dotLottie delivery
Authenticated API, CLI, MCP and durable batches
Self-hosted HTTP worker execution with verified object transfer
guardrails: Public hub metadata never authorizes access
Owner and client launches require verified hub identity and application access
Cross-app handoffs expire after two minutes and are consumed once
Vector Studio sessions use a separate app-private signing authority
Production replay storage must be durable and atomic
No signing secret, worker token, provider token or local filesystem path is public
No generated output is automatically production approved
Client release remains disabled until promotion evidence is complete
